topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling affects link budgets by increasing interference and degrading signal quality. Adaptive modulation, coding schemes, and beamforming techniques can mitigate this, optimizing power and bandwidth allocation to maintain navigation signal quality and safety margins.
reference_context: Link budgets depend on power, bandwidth, and antenna characteristics, with prioritization affecting signal quality and safety margins.
